newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates steady at high levels.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates steady at high levels.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates remained steady at high levels on Saturday amid a shortage of liquidity and are likely to open at similar levels on Sunday, dealers said.
"Once agains the overnight rates traded at the same level of 20 percent (as on the last trading session on Thursday)," dealer Imran Ahad at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Ahad said banks availed of the State (central) Bank of Pakistan discount window facility to square their positions. About 15 billion rupees were discounted.
